purpose: Build a CRM that connects requests, proposal preparation, signing, payment and assessment in one job record.
outcome: Reduce repeated admin and give the team a clear owner, current documents and next task for each job.

problems.detail: Read the request email, then enter the same details in the job system.
problems.impact: Paid staff time is spent repeating information the customer already supplied.

problems.detail: Find the right template, fees and forms; check the current plan revision.
problems.impact: Each job needs manual assembly and checking before it can progress.

problems.detail: Check separate systems and tell the next person when the job is ready.
problems.impact: Staff spend time checking status and chasing the handover.

cost.source: ACT retained discovery notes describe the work but do not quantify the cost.

build_summary: One staff workspace connected to the tools the business already uses.

deliverables.name: Intake and job record
deliverables.does: Capture the request, contacts and uploaded plans. Assign a quoting owner and task.
deliverables.fixes: Repeated data entry and unclear responsibility.

deliverables.name: Proposals and documents
deliverables.does: Use approved templates, fee schedules and forms. Keep current files distinct from superseded revisions.
deliverables.fixes: Manual document assembly and version checking.

deliverables.name: Signing and payment
deliverables.does: Connect DocuSign and Xero status to the job. Assign assessment only at the approved payment milestone.
deliverables.fixes: Separate acceptance/payment checks and handover chasing.

deliverables.name: Tasks and inspections
deliverables.does: Assign work, connect the Microsoft calendar and record agreed booking reminders and replies.
deliverables.fixes: Manual status updates and booking coordination.

human_control: Staff approve fees, proposal content and certification decisions. AI may suggest an approved template; staff can override it.
scope_boundary: First agreed workflow, approved templates and staff roles. Historical migration and extra reports require an agreed inventory before the scope is signed.

workflow.title: Request received
workflow.detail: The submitted details and plans are on one enquiry. A named staff member checks the information and prepares the proposal.

workflow.title: Proposal approved
workflow.detail: Staff check the approved template, fee lines, documents and signers. Missing information stays as a staff task; nothing sends without approval.

workflow.title: Signed and paid
workflow.detail: Signed documents return to the record. The payment milestone is checked separately before an assessment task is assigned.

workflow.title: Assessment and inspection
workflow.detail: The assessor receives the current plans and checklist. Inspection bookings and replies stay linked to the job; changes create an action for staff.

rows.work: Confirm the workflow, screens, templates, access and exact first-release scope.
Build the workspace and connect the agreed request, signing, invoice and booking workflow.
Run representative jobs and exceptions, correct defects and train staff.
Complete the agreed cutover and hand over access, documentation and support.

timeline.condition: Confirm dates after technical scoping, ACT access and the exact migration inventory.

dependencies: A named client contact, approved templates and fees, sample jobs, account access and feedback at the review points.

commercial.conditions: Final fees, payment stages and support terms to be approved before issue.

support_scope: [Confirm support fee, hours, response times and defect cover before issue.]
decision: Proceed with the agreed CRM scope and commercial terms.
next_steps: Sign the implementation agreement and pay the initial invoice.
Nominate the client contact and provide the agreed accounts and materials.
Hold the kickoff and confirm the first design review.
